description:
The hook strategy library: every kind of long-form hook the shared index holds at least
    3 openings of, with its plain name, count, the median multiple of those videos over their
    channels' usual views, the median hook length in seconds, the template most share, and up
    to 3 real examples (title, hook as said, video_id, channel, multiple). Counted from the
    index, never by a model; public data only. Free. Same as GET /v1/strategies.

q.description: a subject: only openings of videos whose title or channel match its words
